positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · Hybrid

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description: Responsible for various systems that ingest the live statistical feeds from the arenas into the database and create live XML.  Integrate various windows and web services to validate the state of the system and generate further feeds.  Contributed to the redesign of nba.com/stats.  Also wrote the system that feed data into scoreboards for All Star Saturday Night.

positions.title: Research and Development Engineer 2
positions.description: Develop new controls and features for the ASP.NET product suite, including responsibility for the most complex controls, the WebDataGrid and WebHierarchicalGrid.  Research and create the original jQuery Mobile controls for the product, including the igListView and igRating.  Assist in the development of the new Infragistics website, built on top of jQuery and MVC.  Work with rest of the team to deliver samples, documentation, and a quality product.
